_note: Kawasemi-yu, the public bath in Yumachi, inside (2026-11-22, Baths step 2; docs/DESIGN.md → ที่อาบน้ำ). One bath for everyone in bathing wraps (the user's pick: the farmer has no set gender, so no men's and women's sides). Left the lobby: a packed-earth entry by the door with the shoe lockers, wooden floor, the counter (shop sento in data/shops.json: the milk; the 120 G entry was paid at the street door, Game.use_door), the milk fridge, a bench along the left wall and the shelf of baskets for clothes. Right, through the noren in the partition, the bath: a tiled floor, the washing island with its taps, stools and buckets, and the big tub along the back wall under the painted mountain (bath_mural: Ogura in our own painting). E from the row in front of the tub (`seats`: front) gets in (data/baths.json sento, Game.soak). The clock stands still in here like in every building; the day's first bath takes its hour. name: Kawasemi-yu

props.message: A glass-fronted cooler of milk bottles, beaded with cold. Pay at the counter.
Rattan baskets for clothes, one to a bather.
A long bench, worn smooth. A good place to cool off.
Shoe lockers with wooden keys. Yours is number eight.
Ogura painted across the back wall, the river at its foot. The steam softens it.
A row of taps and little mirrors, a stool and a bucket at each. Wash first, then soak.
